user_questions.question: (1) Flag via new checkbox Storefront__c.Flagged_For_Attention__c (recommended) or a new Status__c value; and notify the Contact in Primary_Contact__c by email? (2) When the 10-review average recovers to 3.0+, clear the flag automatically or leave it for manual clearing? (3) No storefront has 10 reviews yet (2-8 each): evaluate on available reviews (4 would be below 3.0 today) or wait for 10?
user_questions.simulated_answer: A checkbox flag on the storefront is fine. Notify by email to the storefront's primary contact. Clear the flag automatically when the recent average recovers to 3.0 or more. Apex is acceptable. (3) No preference; use your recommended default.

skill_friction: Combined R+T call (allowed for <=5 changes at 500 words) timed out at 60s; the templates' guidance that ~400 words finishes in time did not hold for the combined call. Splitting into R and T after the timeout worked. Unclear whether the separate T call after the R retry counts as a retry or a new call.
RUNNER kind list has 'rt' and 'retry' but no way to record that a retry was a narrowed R-only call; recorded retry.

AskCoworker repeatedly cited 'prior session' queries (OWD, templates, DataStream, FLS) despite the ignore-earlier-conversations header; SKILL says drop or verify, which required extra queries each time.

SKILL step 7 says any responsibility gap goes back to step 5, but the auto-clear decision leaves a delete/undelete gap that the one-message/3-question budget was already spent on; recorded as non-blocking with a proposal rather than re-asking. SKILL does not say whether a second scope-check round is allowed.

AskCoworker asserted platform behaviors (invocable called once per record in bulk; 10 emails per transaction) that contradict documented behavior; Rule 3 covers recording the conflict, but there is no guidance on whether to let a contradicted AskCoworker 'blocking' label drive design.
Choosing without sharing vs with sharing for the Apex action was not covered by any template question; R answer proposed with sharing, which was corrected from verified sharing facts.
